name: HubSpot - Lead Assignment to COLD CALLERS

nodes.name: Get leads count to be assigned

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "filterGroups": [
    {
      "filters": [
        { "propertyName": "lifecyclestage", "operator": "EQ", "value": "lead" },
        { "propertyName": "confirmed_website___headquarters_phone__", "operator": "HAS_PROPERTY" },
        { "propertyName": "total_monthly_visits", "operator": "BETWEEN", "value": "1000", "highValue": "60000" },
        { "propertyName": "hubspot_owner_id", "operator": "NOT_HAS_PROPERTY" },
        {
          "propertyName": "hs_lead_status",
          "operator": "NOT_IN",
          "values": [
            "Unqualified Low Weight",
            "Unqualified Non US based",
            "Unqualified Bad Product Type",
            "Unqualified Revenue Plus 100 mil",
            "Unqualified Revenue Less 1 mil",
            "DM located BUT cannot reach",
            "Unqualified Cannot Reach",
            "Unqualified Website Down",
            "Unqualified Cannot Compete Pricing",
            "Unqualified Not Interested",
            "# of leads changed to unqualified not interested from UNKNOWN",
            "Unqualified Junk Lead / No shipping"
          ]
        },
        {
          "propertyName": "hs_revenue_range",
          "operator": "NOT_IN",
          "values": ["$50M - $100M", "$100m - $200M", "$250M - $500M", "$500M - $1B"]
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "properties": [
    "name",
    "hs_lead_status",
    "hubspot_owner_id",
    "industry_type_verified",
    "annualrevenue",
    "hs_revenue_range",
    "apollo_annual_revenue_number_fix_use_this",
    "notes_last_contacted"
  ],
  "limit": 200
}
